A lot about the world is very heavy right now but if a college football podcast that got jettisoned by Vox during the pandemic for not having a marketable audience can raise this much money for refugees in Atlanta in two days then just think of all the stuff we can all do together

When I worked on legislation that would make platforms pay journalists for scraping journalism it got called a “link tax,” but when platforms make journalists pay the platform to post links it’s just good ol capitalism.
I was telling my partner about my after-work routine and basically realized I had reinvented the experience of studying at the library
BREAKING: Eight children, ranging in age from 1 to 14 years old, were killed in a Louisiana shooting, police say.
young pope leo looks like a ska scene regular who goes by Upbeat but no one knows his real name
Here’s my testimony on AB 2222 from this week — the sponsor is @asmchrisward.bsky.social who has been a great champion for local media in California this session.

A very cool thing I’ve been getting to do recently is collaborate with @sagaftra.org recently on a local journalists jobs bill in California for @rebuildlocalnews.bsky.social! Unions, they’re great folks.

The South Korean national tax agency gives out a "model taxpayer" award every year, often to k-pop stars and actors, and the recipients serve as a PR ambassadors for the agency for the following year.

"losing the decades-old tax breaks could hinder its ability to maintain its headquarters in Richmond and carry out its operations." ah well, isn't that kind of the tradition? www.nytimes.com/2026/04/14/u...
JD Vance stories are funny because half the time they’re like “the Vice President, a Catholic, [saying the most Protestant thing you’ve ever heard]”
[board meeting] well when you really think about it AI is like a shoe for your head
